gameDescriptionHtml:
“7th Domain” is a horizontal version action game derived from a roguelike metroidvania combined with treasure grinding gameplay. You will play a child of destiny who repairs the world and finds the truth of the broken world. You will grow in battle and challenge the unknown and hidden forces.

Game Features

  • Delicate pixel-style action combat experience – Create the ultimate 2D pixel-based battle experience in the name of ACT!
  • Varied combat challenges – This world provides a variety of combinations of weapons and skills, each of which can bring different strategies and combat experiences. At the same time, it also combines the characteristics of horizontal action games to create secrets for this world.
  • Finding equipment and affixes: Mix and match at will – This world provides a wide variety of equipment affixes, which can be assembled into various attribute tactics. Use such a mechanism to pay tribute to the pursuit of the sword and magic era.
  • Talent building at your discretion – This world has both hierarchy and repeated deaths. The way of progress requires you and me to pursue. Paying tribute is also progressing.
  • Tarot-like echo collection – Explore and challenge this world with a tarot-style collection to fill your loot!
